correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs exact pre-update parent probability ratios for arbitrary binary donation states and all b,c,delta>0; the cost coefficient yields the necessary and sufficient stochastic-row identity for every common-neighbor pair. Connected graphs with no induced three-path are precisely complete graphs; even-walk classes separate bipartite and nonbipartite cases. This establishes exhaustive options. On cliques, constant relative fitness and exact birth–death product yield the fixation expression and strict sign transition. A standalone integer/rational checker corroborates finite test cases; no finite computation is substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This is a motivated complete identifiability classification for a recently introduced evolution-of-cooperation model: entire heterogeneous comparison profiles are invisible on exactly bicliques (outside the zero case), while on cliques comparison can reverse selection exactly beyond a determined threshold. It distinguishes observable process laws from behavior parameters at every finite selection strength; an exact edge-deletion example shows the structural obstruction is sharp. The known fixed-fitness fixation formula alone is not claimed valuable or original.
